verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is Fieldwork, where AI agents "collect, validate, and package the evidence." That is AI processing the customer's compliance data, but it is evidence automation rather than insights or suggestions surfaced to the user. The MCP server and service keys let an external assistant reason over Oneleet data, but that happens outside the product, so it only partly fits the story. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI-generated insights or recommendations (e.g., gap analysis, risk summaries, remediation suggestions), clarity on whether Fieldwork is part of the Oneleet platform, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
